nodes.label: MANUAL_SCAN_MAX_LEN
nodes.doc: Above this length the chained `.replace` wins: it scans in C++, whereas the manual loop pays a JS iteration per character.

nodes.label: markHtml
nodes.doc: Wrap a compiled template as SafeHtml (the compiled output's `_html`).

nodes.label: NEEDS_ESCAPE
nodes.doc: Most rendered strings (labels, ids, class names, numbers) contain none of the four HTML-significant characters, so a single scan that bails early avoids any rewriting pass at all in the common case.

nodes.label: readAmbient
nodes.doc: The ambient value for `key`, or `fallback` when nothing is installed.

nodes.label: SafeHtml
nodes.doc: Shared HTML serialization primitives, used by BOTH the runtime walker (ExoNodeString) and the compiled SSR output, so the two emit byte-identical HTML.

nodes.label: serializeAttribute
nodes.doc: One attribute → its HTML: `name="v"`, a bare `name` (boolean true), or `''` when it must not render (children/textContent/directives/events/functions or a false/null/undefined value).
